scope.title: Evidence Pack — Scope
scope.summary: Assemble, preserve, and deliver a defensible collection of evidence (documents, records, and artifacts) relevant to the specified matter to enable investigation, litigation, or compliance review. The scope defines what will be collected, the time period, data sources, stakeholders, exclusions, constraints, and expected deliverables.
objectives: Identify and collect all relevant documents, files, and records tied to the matter
Preserve chain-of-custody and metadata for collected items to maintain evidentiary integrity
Process and produce a usable, searchable evidence set for analysis and review
Provide a clear evidence index and documentation of collection, processing, and retention steps
in_scope: Email and mailbox content for custodians identified as relevant
Documents and files from identified on-premise and cloud file stores (e.g., shared drives, collaboration platforms)
System logs and access records relevant to the timeframe and custodians
Relevant attachments, calendars, and messaging platform content for identified custodians
Metadata for all collected items (timestamps, authorship, file paths, hash values)
out_of_scope: Personal data unrelated to the matter (unless specifically requested)
Systems, custodians, or date ranges not listed by the requesting party
Live forensic imaging of devices unless separately authorized
Destruction or alteration of original sources beyond preserved copies

timeframe.note: Exact date range to be filled after scoping interview or per user-supplied parameters

stakeholders.responsibilities: Define matter, custodians, date range, privilege rules, and approval for scope changes
Execute collections, document chain-of-custody, and deliver collected evidence
Process data, apply de-duplication, indexing, and prepare productions or review sets

evidence_types: File system documents (shared drives, cloud storage)
Database extracts and structured data exports
data_sources: Corporate file shares and collaboration platforms (SharePoint, OneDrive, Google Drive, Box)
Endpoint file systems and managed backups (if authorized)
constraints: Collections limited to custodians, systems, and date ranges authorized by the requesting party
Legal, regulatory, or privacy restrictions must be honored (hold notices, privileged material)
Access to some systems may be delayed pending credentials or administrator approvals
success_criteria: Complete evidence set delivered for the authorized scope and timeframe
All collected items documented with hashes and chain-of-custody records
Searchable index and exports provided in agreed formats
Privilege and confidentiality protections applied and documented
deliverables: Forensically exported copies of collected items with metadata and hash manifest
Evidence index/catalog describing items, custodians, date ranges, and collection methods
Documentation of chain-of-custody and collection procedures
Processed, de-duplicated review set in agreed format (PST/ZIP/EDRM/CSV as requested)
Privilege log or redaction report if applicable

retention_and_security.storage_requirements: Secure encrypted storage with access controls; retention and destruction policies per requesting party and applicable law
retention_and_security.access_controls: Role-based access, logging of access, and limited distribution of originals

scope.notes: This scope is a template. Specific custodians, date ranges, privileged treatment rules, jurisdictional requirements, and any additional inclusions/exclusions should be provided to finalize the scope prior to collection.
